scope: Development preview on a Windows 11 development host. Test tasks, projects, transport and model endpoints were isolated; no cloud account used.

observations: A preview added after confirmation opened invalidated the old plan; cancellation retained all local records.
Cleanup removed only A previews; the B preview remained usable and same-name files were unchanged.
A pending edit remained reviewable. Applied edits disclosed the lost undo entry before confirmation.
The captured browser quote became unavailable after cleaning its project, and a fresh selection still completed a turn.
Same-path SSH peers and a changed fingerprint could not use the original cleanup plan. Remote files were unchanged.
Full 64-row index, legacy-only records, pending records, scratch directories, external replacement and locked-index retry were covered by storage tests.
